# custom Provider

Interact with Custom API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configuration-based authentication
provider "custom" {
  host  = "http://localhost:3000"
  token = "21097dc18cfb54ebb691098b6dcf556418f9a6d2640db2217a529c"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) URI for Custom API. May also be provided via CUSTOM_HOST environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Token for Custom API. May also be provided via CUSTOM_TOKEN environment variable.
